description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'CollateralNotFoundException' used in the context of handling cases where collateral resources are not found within the financial application's collateral module. It extends an abstract exception provided by the platform core and provides multiple constructors for different error scenarios.

classes.name: CollateralNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating that a specific collateral resource was not found, either for a given loan or by collateral ID.

methods.name: CollateralNotFoundException(final Long loanId, final Long collateralId)
methods.description: Constructs an exception indicating that collateral with the specified collateralId does not exist for the given loanId.

methods.name: CollateralNotFoundException(final Long id)
methods.description: Constructs an exception indicating that a loan collateral with the specified ID does not exist.

methods.name: CollateralNotFoundException(Long loanId, Long collateralId, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructs an exception similar to the first constructor, including the underlying data access exception.
